name: hydrogenated polybutene (1300 mw) + niacinamide + squalane + trehalose
purpose: Purpose Whitening Agent Repair Moisturizing agent Moisturizer
uses: Use shake well before use, take an appropriate amount of the product and apply it evenly to the facial skin. Gently massage until absorbed.
otcwarn: Do not use OPEN SKIN WOUND Stop use and ask a doctor if irritation or rash occurs. These may be signs of a serious condition.
